learning_objective: 🎯 Let us use math to buy tickets, calculate travel distances, and solve fun money puzzles at the museum!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we visit a museum, we need to buy tickets. We use addition and multiplication to find the total price for our whole family to enter.
If we give a big money note to the shopkeeper, we must subtract the ticket price to know exactly how much change we will get back.
We can calculate how far the museum is from our house or school by measuring the long travel distance in Kilometers.

fun_activity.title: 🎟️ Pretend Ticket Counter
fun_activity.instructions: Make pretend paper money and tickets. Play with your sibling or friend and calculate the total cost for 3 museum tickets!

quick_recap: ⭐ We use addition and multiplication to find the total cost of many tickets.
⭐ Subtraction helps us know how much money we should get back as change.
⭐ We measure long travel distances between cities or buildings in Kilometers.
